metadata.title: How to treat dry skin: Dermatologist tips for relief
metadata.description:
Dry skin can flake, itch, crack, and even bleed. These tips from board-certified dermatologists can help you heal excessively dry skin at home.

Learn more at https://www.aad.org/public/everyday-care/skin-care-basics/dry/dermatologists-tips-relieve-dry-skin.

00:00 Intro

00:55 4) Apply lip balm

01:38 7) Check your clothes
